description: This file defines data models for users and items, including database models, API schemas, and utility functions, for a backend application using SQLModel and Pydantic.

classes.name: UserBase
classes.description: Shared properties for user-related models, including email, active status, superuser status, and full name.

classes.name: UserCreate
classes.description: Schema for creating a new user, extending UserBase with a password field.

classes.name: UserRegister
classes.description: Schema for user registration API, including email, password, and full name.

classes.name: UserUpdate
classes.description: Schema for updating user information, all fields optional.

classes.name: UserUpdateMe
classes.description: Schema for updating current user's profile, including full name and email.

classes.name: UpdatePassword
classes.description: Schema for password update, requiring current and new passwords.

classes.name: User
classes.description: Database model representing a user, including id, hashed password, creation timestamp, and relationship to items.

classes.name: UserPublic
classes.description: Schema for publicly exposing user info, including id and creation date.

classes.name: UsersPublic
classes.description: Schema for a list of public user data with count.

classes.name: ItemBase
classes.description: Shared properties for item models, including title and description.

classes.name: ItemUpdate
classes.description: Schema for updating an item, with optional title.

classes.name: Item
classes.description: Database model for an item, including id, timestamps, owner id, and relationship to owner.

classes.name: ItemPublic
classes.description: Schema for publicly exposing item info.

classes.name: ItemsPublic
classes.description: Schema for a list of public item data with count.

classes.name: NewPassword
classes.description: Schema for setting a new password, including token and new password.
